prompt_text: Who is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City to help me pick a plan?
ai_overview_text:
Top-rated local health insurance brokers in the Kansas City metro area include BBS Insurance, AIS Health Insurance Advisors, Jeff David Insurance, and Benefit Services. www.health-insurance-kansas-city.com +3
Services: Individual and family marketplace or private health plans, small group health (2–50 employees), Medicare, and supplemental insurance.
Ratings & Details: 5.0 rating on Google (90+ reviews) and BBB A+ accreditation.
Locations: Offices in North Kansas City (MO), Lawson (MO), and Overland Park (KS).
Contact: (816) 205-4664 or text (816) 371-8718 BBS Insurance Inc.
Services: Independent guidance for Medicare (Advantage, Supplement, Part D), individual/family health plans, ACA Marketplace, small business plans, and network doctor verification.
Ratings & Details: Over 15 years in business with a 5.0 Google rating, led by Travis Allen.
Location: Based in Overland Park, KS; serving the entire Kansas City metro including Jackson County, Brookside, Waldo, Lee's Summit, and Independence. AIS Health Insurance Advisors +1
Services: Medicare enrollment, ACA Marketplace health plans, dental, life, and travel insurance.
Ratings & Details: Operating since 1993, Marketplace Elite Circle of Champions, Aetna Frontrunner, and 5-star rated on Google and Facebook.
Contact: (816) 436-2622 Jeff David Insurance
Services: Individual, family, and small business health insurance brokerage.
Details: Handles shopping, paperwork, and enrollment at no extra cost compared to the public Marketplace.
Contact: Shawn Moulin at (913-341-9393 ext. 2) or via Benefit Services.
Cost: Working with an independent health insurance broker is free to you. Brokers are paid directly by the insurance carriers (like Blue KC, UnitedHealthcare, or Aetna), and your plan rates will not be higher than if you enrolled on your own. Benefit Services of Kansas City +1
Network Verification: Make sure the broker checks whether your preferred local health systems—such as Saint Luke's, Research Medical Center, Truman Medical Centers/University Health, or North Kansas City Hospital—are in-network for the specific plan you select. AIS Health Insurance Advisors
